2610.08553.title: DeltaTTT: Layerwise Optimization for Nonlinear Recurrent Memory
2610.08553.paper_summary: Sequential test-time training adapts a memory network through successive updates, each computing an inner-loop gradient based on the network's previous state. Intuitively, this state dependence should allow each update to account for what the memory has already learned and better incorporate new information. However, we find that this expected advantage does not consistently materialize in nonlinear memories: a fixed-base parallel TTT baseline outperforms its serial counterpart. Our exploratory experiments point to a key underlying difficulty: nonlinear memories can be harder to optimize than linear ones within a single pass over the sequence. To alleviate this optimization difficulty, we introduce DeltaTTT, which replaces joint inner-loop optimization of a two-layer memory network with layerwise learning. Each layer is assigned a local prediction target and updated through a state-dependent delta rule. This formulation retains a nonlinear readout while enabling chunkwise parallel computation. Experiments on DeltaNet and LaCT backbones show improvements in language modeling and retrieval over their recurrent baselines.
2610.08553.paper_summary_zh: 序列測試時訓練通過連續更新來調整記憶網絡，每次計算基於網絡先前狀態的內部循環梯度。直觀上，這種狀態依賴性應該允許每次更新考慮記憶已經學到的內容，並更好地融入新信息。然後，我們發現這一預期的優勢在非線性記憶中並不總是實現：固定基準的並行 TTT 基線表現優於其串行對應物。我們的探索性實驗指出了一個關鍵的潛在困難：在對序列進行單次遍歷時，非線性記憶的優化可能比線性記憶更具挑戰性。為了緩解這一優化困難，我們引入了 DeltaTTT，該方法用分層學習取代了二層記憶網絡的聯合內部循環優化。每一層都被分配了一個局部預測目標，並通過狀態依賴的增量規則進行更新。這一公式保留了非線性讀出，同時實現了分塊並行計算。在 DeltaNet 和 LaCT 主幹上的實驗顯示，在語言建模和檢索方面相較於其循環基準有了改進。
